category_title: Pupils with persistent disruptive and aggressive/abusive behavior
scenario_title: Support group reflection on past conflict
minimal_context: The student is participating in a weekly support group meeting and is asked to use their diary to reflect on a recent conflict.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at your support group diary and reflect on the conflict that happened yesterday. Can you tell me what the gains and losses were from that situation?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why do I have to do this? It wasn't my mistake. He was deliberately doing things to annoy me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We still need to talk about your reaction. Why did you get so angry?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know! I don't understand why I behave in the ways that I do. You're always just trying to blame me.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just need to calm down and try to control your behavior when we discuss these things.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Loses temper) I can't control my behaviour when I want to! And I definitely can't control my behaviour when under pressure from you!
